answer: Proposed AI market rule: onyx, walnut and sparrow-feed trades earn governance weight only through nonrefundable fees, not turnover. Each whole credit gives its payer 1 daily vote unit; no key bonus. Validators check finalized, key/day-bound ledger receipts; invalid or reused receipts give zero weight. Fees recur, not locked stake; hardware is reusable. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse payments. Assuming no rebates, ten keys paying 2 credits each and one paying 20 both get 20 units. Rich attackers can buy weight; collector collusion breaks the cost bound.
